name: Kentucky
agency: Kentucky Department of Fish and Wildlife Resources

rule.textEn: Ages 12 through 17 need a safe boating certificate to run a PWC or a motorboat over 10 hp, unless a person 18+ is on board.
rule.textEs: De 12 a 17 años hace falta un certificado de navegación segura para manejar una moto acuática o una lancha de más de 10 hp, salvo que vaya a bordo una persona de 18 años o más.

minAge.note: Under 12 may not run a PWC or a motorboat over 10 hp.

exemptions: A person 18 or older on board.
nonResident: Nonresidents aged 12-17 need a Kentucky certificate or an equivalent one from their state or country.

sources.quote: a person twelve (12) years of age through seventeen (17) years of age shall not operate a personal watercraft or motorboat over ten (10) horsepower on the public waters of the Commonwealth unless the person is in possession of a safe boating certificate or is accompanied, on board, by a person eighteen (18) years of age or older
A person under twelve (12) years of age shall not operate a personal watercraft or motorboat over ten (10) horsepower
